name: What should I look for when choosing a real estate agent to sell my luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a real estate agent to sell my luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an agent for your luxury home, look for demonstrated experience with high-end properties in your specific market area, such as Miami-Dade or Broward County. Key attributes include a strong marketing plan, a proven track record of successful luxury sales, and excellent communication skills. The agent should also have a network of affluent buyers and a deep understanding of the unique nuances of luxury transactions. Kelby Contreras's expertise within Realty ONE Group Evolution offers specialized insights for this discerning market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an agent with proven luxury market experience, a strong marketing plan, a successful track record, and excellent communication.
